summary: Re-test of the 6 iteration_12 fixes plus full Phase E/F/G + Phase A-D regression. ALL 6 FIXES VERIFIED. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_phaseefg.py from 22 to 32 tests with a dedicated TestIteration12Fixes class (10 new tests): sign visibility enforcement (private_draft 403, admins_only 403, assigned member 200 + signature row created), non-destructive partial PUT (audience/assigned_to/assigned_roles preserved; member retains access) and full-object PUT still working, invalid audience -> 400 on create and edit, archive of non-existent id -> 404, DELETE blocked when assigned_roles non-empty (400 'archive it instead', doc still present), convert on a 'New' application -> 400 with no member created. Phase E/F/G: 32/32 (1 email-provider flake). Phase A-D regression: 150/151 (only failure is the same email provider flake). UI verified via Playwright as staff (audLabel fallback now renders 'Private Draft — Not Assigned' for a legacy doc with no audience field, zero 'undefined' across all meta lines; UI create + UI full-object edit preserved audience=all_active) and as ambassador member (only visible docs listed, no New Document button, sign succeeded on a visible doc). All artifacts cleaned; evt_246d20a66b31 left Approved/published with checkin_assignees=[].

minor.issue: Partial PUT is now non-destructive (exclude_unset) BUT DocumentIn still declares title and category as required, so a body of {assigned_roles:[...]} alone returns 422. Only bodies that include title+category can be partial. Acceptable for the current UI (it always sends the full object) but if a true PATCH-style API is intended, split out a DocumentEditIn with all-Optional fields.

STILL PRESENT (unchanged from it_12, treated as infra flake per instructions): provider returns no message id intermittently (~50% of sends in this run) -> email_log status 'failed', error 'Provider did not return a message id'. Same address (delivered@resend.dev) succeeds on retry. No retry/backoff. Causes flaky failures in test_phaseefg::test_convert_assigns_ambassador_docs_and_sends_welcome and test_phaseb_regmgmt::test_manual_no_auto_confirmation_email.
Still supports audience 'interns_only' / role 'intern' while ROLES has no 'intern' role — dead branch (carried over from it_12, not a regression).

ui_bugs.issue: a11y console warning persists: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' on both the create/edit and sign dialogs. Cosmetic/a11y only.
'Assign to all active' menu item still has no data-testid (Edit/Archive/Delete do).

action_items: Optional: add retry/backoff (or a queue) around log_and_send so a transient 'no message id' provider response does not permanently mark welcome/confirmation emails 'failed'. This is the only remaining recurring failure.
Optional: make title/category Optional in the edit payload (dedicated DocumentEditIn) if true partial PATCH semantics are desired; today a partial PUT must still include title+category or it 422s.
Optional (LOW): add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to Documents dialogs and a data-testid to the 'Assign to all active' menu item.
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 fixes are implemented correctly and defensively: sign_document mirrors _doc_visible_to, edit_document uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) + audience validation, create_document validates audience, archive_document 404s on missing doc, delete_document guards signatures + assigned_to + assigned_roles + audience!=private_draft, convert_to_member gates on status in (Approved, Recommended, Recommended for Approval).
server.py is now 2839 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (documents, events/registrations, applications/members, email).
audience validation is duplicated in create_document and edit_document; move it into a Pydantic field_validator on DocumentIn to keep the two paths in sync.

rca_of_the_issue: No new product defects. The single recurring test failure is external: send_email returns without a provider message id (~50% of calls) so log_and_send marks the row 'failed'; identical payload/address succeeds on retry, confirming a provider rate-limit/quota condition rather than an application bug. Everything else previously reported in iteration_12 is fixed and covered by regression tests.
